description: Flexible spending analytics. Groups expenses by day, weekday, week, month, category, merchant or item, with optional filters: amount range, categories, merchants and text. Use it for questions such as "on which weekday do I spend most", "all purchases over 50", "coffee spending per month" or "how much at Lidl by category". Amounts are in the user currency. Expenses have a date but no time of day, so it cannot group by hour. With groupBy category or item, or a categories or text filter, it counts single items; otherwise it counts whole expenses. groupBy day allows at most 92 days and week at most 3 years.

categories.description: Category codes; only items in these categories count — use get_categories for codes

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for today

limit.description: Max groups for category, merchant and item (default 10); the rest is summed in "other"

maxAmount.description: Count only expenses (or items, when items are counted) of at most this amount

merchants.description: Merchant names; an expense counts when its merchant contains one of them (case-insensitive)

minAmount.description: Count only expenses (or items, when items are counted) of at least this amount

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD; omit for all time

text.description: Only items whose name or merchant contains this text (case-insensitive), for example "coffee"

name: query_spending
title: Query spending
